# GroupDocs.Total MCP Server

Unified MCP server for the GroupDocs.Total document toolset — annotate, sign, convert, watermark, parse, redact, compose markdown, merge / split, read metadata, compare, plus cross-product document info and page preview. 38 AI-callable tools across 10 product domains, one MCP endpoint. Do NOT attach the per-product GroupDocs MCPs (Annotation.Mcp, Signature.Mcp, etc.) alongside — Total bundles all of them.

## Install

Docker-first product - the packed tool exceeds NuGet.org's 250 MB limit, so there is no dnx / NuGet path. Multi-arch image (amd64 + arm64) on GHCR only; pin by replacing :latest with a version tag.

- As a Docker container: `docker run --rm -i -v $(pwd)/documents:/data ghcr.io/groupdocs-total/total-net-mcp:latest`

## MCP tools

Tool naming: cross-product tools are short (GetDocumentInfo, GetDocumentPageImage); per-product tools use `{Product}{Verb}{Noun}` PascalCase. Each tool's `[Description]` opens with `[GroupDocs.<Product>]` so AI agents can disambiguate.

### Cross-product (2)
- GetDocumentInfo — file type, page count, size as JSON (Parser engine, 170+ formats)
- GetDocumentPageImage — render up to 5 pages as inline PNG images (Viewer engine)

### Annotation (8)
- AnnotationAddAnnotation, AnnotationGetAnnotations, AnnotationUpdateAnnotation, AnnotationRemoveAnnotations, AnnotationAddReply, AnnotationRemoveReplies, AnnotationImportAnnotations, AnnotationExportAnnotations

### Signature (7)
- SignatureSign, SignatureVerify, SignatureSearchTextSignatures, SignatureSearchBarcodes, SignatureSearchQrCodes, SignatureSearchDigitalSignatures, SignatureSearchImageSignatures

### Comparison (1) · Conversion (2) · Markdown (2)
- ComparisonCompare
- ConversionConvert, ConversionGetSupportedFormats
- MarkdownConvertToMarkdown, MarkdownComposeFromMarkdown

### Merger (2) · Metadata (2)
- MergerMerge, MergerSplit
- MetadataReadMetadata, MetadataRemoveMetadata

### Parser (5) · Redaction (4) · Watermark (3)
- ParserExtractText, ParserExtractImages, ParserExtractTables, ParserExtractMetadata, ParserExtractBarcodes
- RedactionRedactText, RedactionRedactImageArea, RedactionRedactAnnotations, RedactionEraseMetadata
- WatermarkAddWatermark, WatermarkSearchWatermarks, WatermarkRemoveWatermarks

## Skipped from the GroupDocs.Total engine bundle

Editor / Assembly / Search are bundled but their MCP tools are NOT exposed in this release — these engines have parameter shapes (DataSource models, persistent index paths, schema-heavy edit DTOs) that AI agents struggle to specify well. Use the standalone per-product MCPs (when they exist) if you need them.

## Supported formats

170+ document and image formats including PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODP, ODS, RTF, HTML, EPUB, MOBI, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, CAD, EML, MSG, VSDX, XPS, MD, and many more (per the GroupDocs.Total bundle).

## Environment variables

- GROUPDOCS_MCP_STORAGE_PATH — base folder for input + output (defaults to current working directory)
- GROUPDOCS_MCP_OUTPUT_PATH — optional, routes output files to a separate folder
- GROUPDOCS_LICENSE_PATH — path to GroupDocs.Total.lic, omit for evaluation mode (the TotalLicenseManager applies the license to every bundled product engine)

## Licensing

The MCP server is MIT; the underlying GroupDocs engines require a license for production use. Evaluation mode (no license): Each bundled engine applies its own evaluation limits: output watermarks / evaluation notices, page limits, and per-process document-open caps (1-15 documents depending on the engine). Mount GroupDocs.Total.lic into the container and set GROUPDOCS_LICENSE_PATH. Free 30-day temporary license: https://purchase.groupdocs.com/temporary-license/ - purchase: https://purchase.groupdocs.com/pricing/total/net

## Example prompts for AI agents

- "Convert contract.docx to PDF, sign it with a QR code 'Signed by Alice', then watermark every page with 'CONFIDENTIAL'"
- "Compare old.pdf and new.pdf, list every annotation in the result, and preview page 1"
- "Extract all tables from report.xlsx as Markdown and redact every email address"
- "Read the metadata of every PDF in /uploads, then strip it, then preview the cleaned page 1 of each"
- "Find every barcode in invoice.pdf, then merge invoice.pdf + receipt.pdf into combined.pdf"
